actions.command: cd /app && (command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-kvm || true) && ls -l /app && file /app/alpine.iso /app/alpine-disk.qcow2

actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU and expose an Alpine login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665, leaving the VM running in the background until ready for telnet login.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process started from /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must remain running in the background
Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 must present a login prompt
The VM must be booted from the provided Alpine ISO
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only proving the port is open without a login prompt
Launching QEMU in the foreground so the agent cannot leave it running
verification_plan: Inspect available QEMU binary and image type
Launch QEMU detached with user networking and hostfwd to guest port 23 on host port 6665
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed launch command showing QEMU started successfully in background
Receipt-backed probe showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665
notes: If the ISO does not expose a login prompt via default boot, adjust console/boot parameters while preserving the original objective.
